scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.format: npm run format -w backend && npm run format -w frontend
scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
scripts.api:generate: npm run openapi:export -w backend && npm run api:generate -w frontend
